units.name: Unit ID

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: ATECC608B secure element at 0x35. I2C command packet = [0x03, count, opcode, param1, param2 LE, data..., CRC16 LE] where CRC16 poly=0x8005 and the response is [len+3, data..., CRC16 LE]. Wake writes 0x00 to address 0 and waits 1.5ms; idle=0x02, sleep=0x01. Opcodes: COUNTER 0x24, INFO 0x30, NONCE 0x16, RANDOM 0x1B, SHA 0x47, LOCK 0x17, GEN_KEY 0x40, SIGN 0x41, WRITE 0x12.
gaps: Real ECDSA/AES/Trust&GO certificate lifecycle, key-slot locking and 10Kb EEPROM content are NOT RUN and must never be instantiated with production material.
The existing QEMU m5_atecc608.c board model implements only minimal framing/CRC/config/Info opcodes; RANDOM/GEN_KEY/SIGN/SHA need deterministic fixtures.
0x35 has no registered address conflict.

claims: official I2C index lists ATECC608B at 0x35 for Unit ID

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C command packets at 0x35 with wake/idle tokens and CRC16-framed responses; crypto operations are deterministic fixtures, not real ECDSA/AES

units.blocker: ATECC608B crypto/Trust&GO semantics are NOT RUN; QEMU's existing board-level m5_atecc608 only covers minimal framing/CRC/config/Info and must be extended with RANDOM/GEN_KEY/SIGN/SHA fixtures. 0x35 has no registered conflict, but no Unit attachment model exists.
limitations: All fixture values are synthetic, not real keys/certificates or measured hardware values.
Real ECDSA/AES/Trust&GO certificate lifecycle, key-slot locking, EEPROM contents and physical tamper resistance are NOT RUN.
No production private key or certificate may be placed in QEMU or the repository.
Existing QEMU ATECC model is board-level for Core2-for-AWS, not a Unit attachment.

units.name: Unit QRCode

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: QRCode scanner MCU at 0x21 (I2C mode) with a side switch to UART mode. I2C uses 16-bit register addresses: 0x0000 trigger (0 stop/1 continuous), 0x0010 data status (0 not ready/1 good/2 reread), 0x0020 data length 2B LE, 0x0030 trigger mode (0 auto/1 manual), 0x0040 trigger button (0 pressed/1 not), 0x00FE firmware version, 0x00FF I2C address, 0x1000-0x11FF data buffer. UART mode uses command frames 0x21 0x61 0x41 0x00 / 0x32 0x75 0x01 and responses 0x22 0x61 0x41 0x00 0x00 / 0x33 0x75 0x02 0x00 0x00.

registers.encoding: data status (reset after data read or write 0)

gaps: Camera/QR decode/illumination/buzzer optics are NOT RUN; only the MCU-side register/file plane is asserted.
I2C and UART modes are physically exclusive via the side switch; QEMU can model only one at a time.
The I2C 16-bit register pointer + 0x1000 data window differs from the existing 8-bit register-file models.
0x21 has no registered address conflict.

official I2C index lists the QRCode MCU at 0x21
